title: Multilingual Global Support Automation
business: International e-commerce retailers requiring 24/7 customer support across diverse linguistic markets.
problem: High operational costs and latency associated with maintaining human-staffed multilingual call centers for routine inquiries.
solution: Leveraging ElevenAgents to deploy conversational AI voice agents that utilize real-time Text to Speech and Speech to Text models to handle customer queries in over 90 languages.
steps: Define the conversational workflow and knowledge base within the ElevenAgents platform.
Select or clone a voice profile that aligns with the brand identity for consistent customer interaction.
Integrate the ElevenAPI into the existing customer support portal to enable low-latency, real-time voice streaming.
Configure the multi-layered safety defense system to ensure all agent responses adhere to brand and compliance guidelines.
outcome: A scalable, consistent, and cost-effective support infrastructure that provides seamless, human-like voice interactions in the customer's native language.
limitation: The reliance on real-time streaming requires stable network conditions; developers should implement client-side buffering and connection monitoring to check for latency spikes.

questions.question: In Multilingual Global Support Automation, what is a primary limitation of the implementation?
options: The inability to support more than two languages simultaneously.
The requirement for high-latency batch processing of all audio files.
The dependence on stable network conditions for real-time streaming.
The lack of integration capabilities with existing customer support portals.
